categories.main_business_segments: Taekyung Chemical Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two main business segments: the Carbon Dioxide Gas segment, which includes the manufacturing and sale of liquid carbon dioxide and dry ice, accounting for 93.3% of sales; and the Environmental segment, producing magnesium hydroxide and liquid lime for flue gas desulfurization and wastewater treatment, representing 6.3% of sales. Additionally, there is a minor Cosmetics segment through a subsidiary. The company also sells general gases such as ethylene, nitrogen, and oxygen mainly for industrial use.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes multiple raw material suppliers and operates several liquid carbon dioxide manufacturing plants, ensuring stable supply. Production involves processing carbon dioxide sourced from petrochemical and refining plants into high-purity liquid carbon dioxide and dry ice. Magnesium hydroxide and liquid lime are produced using MgO and calcined limestone respectively, targeting environmental purification applications. The subsidiary Taekyung Gas Technology manufactures industrial gas vaporizing equipment and mixed gases. The company emphasizes stable supply chain integration and advanced manufacturing facilities with certifications like ISO9001 and FSSC 22000.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include shipbuilders and ice cream manufacturers, with long-term supply contracts to ensure stable sales. The carbon dioxide products serve beverage industries (beer, carbonated drinks), industrial applications (welding, refrigerants, oxidation prevention), and event cooling. Environmental products target flue gas desulfurization and wastewater treatment sectors. The company also serves various industrial sectors with general gases used in steelmaking, semiconductor manufacturing, chemical processing, and medical applications. The cosmetics segment targets the eco-friendly sunscreen market aimed at younger consumers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within South Korea, with manufacturing plants located in Ulsan, Yeosu, Naju, and Daesan. Sales and operations are concentrated domestically, with minor export sales reported. Subsidiaries are based in Ulsan and Seoul, supporting regional market coverage. The company has established distribution and sales teams in Seoul, Ulsan, and Yeosu to serve domestic customers effectively.
categories.supply_chain_position: Taekyung Chemical operates mainly in the midstream segment of the industrial gas supply chain, processing raw carbon dioxide gas sourced from large petrochemical and refining plants into high-purity liquid carbon dioxide and dry ice. It also manufactures and sells environmental chemical products and industrial gas equipment, positioning itself as both a manufacturer and distributor. The company maintains multiple raw material supply sources, enhancing supply stability and acting as a key supplier to downstream industrial and beverage customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses strategically on stable supply capacity expansion, new customer acquisition, and diversification of product applications, especially in the carbon dioxide and dry ice markets. It has recently added dry ice cleaning and manufacturing equipment sales to its business scope to leverage synergies with its core liquid carbon dioxide production. R&D activities are limited, with no significant research projects reported, focusing instead on operational improvements, cost reduction, and yield enhancement. The company also pursues market development in eco-friendly cosmetics through its subsidiary.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of liquid carbon dioxide, dry ice, magnesium hydroxide, and related gases. The company sells products directly to industrial customers and through agents, with long-term supply contracts ensuring stable revenue streams. Minor revenue is derived from cosmetics product sales via a subsidiary. The company also earns income from equipment sales related to dry ice manufacturing. Export sales constitute a small portion of total revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Taekyung Chemical holds a competitive position in the Korean industrial gas market by operating multiple manufacturing plants with diverse raw material suppliers, unlike competitors relying on single-source supply. This multi-source, multi-plant strategy provides a stable supply advantage and creates high entry barriers. The company competes primarily on supply stability and pricing. It is among a few key players in the domestic carbon dioxide and industrial gas sectors, with a strong presence in environmental chemical products and emerging cosmetics markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 707 billion KRW, representing an 18.7% increase from the previous year, and operating income of 179 billion KRW, up 71.9%. Total assets stood at about 183 billion KRW, with equity of 162 billion KRW and a low debt ratio of 12.9%, indicating strong financial health. The company has maintained steady growth in sales and profitability over recent years, supported by capacity expansions and price increases. Return on equity was 10.7% in 2023, reflecting solid returns.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Taekyung Chemical emphasizes stable and reliable supply of high-purity liquid carbon dioxide and dry ice through multiple plants and raw material sources, differentiating itself from competitors with single-source supply. Its diversified product portfolio spans industrial gases, environmental chemicals, and emerging cosmetics, allowing cross-market synergies. The company leverages long-term contracts with key customers to ensure sales stability and focuses on operational efficiency and cost control to enhance profitability. Its regional proximity to customers in industrial complexes provides cost advantages in environmental products.
